title: No Kings protests: Marches are underway around the country
summary: This summer, organizers said more than 5 million people participated in No Kings protests against President Trump. Organizers say they expect an even bigger turnout this time around.

title: LIVE: Israel to receive two more captives’ bodies from Gaza shortly
summary: Armed wing of Hamas recovered the bodies today and the handover will take place at 19:00 GMT in Gaza, the group says.
